reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and holiday helpers, but repeats the skip-versus-move policy instead of sharing the decision implemented in getNextDate.

duplication.why: The daily-frequency exception is independently implemented in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, and budget schedule generation.

placement.why: Holiday recognition belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but server handlers and budget code also own scheduling policy that should live alongside it.

scope.why: The changes are focused on the requested recurrence rules, range handler, supporting types, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several implementations of skip-versus-move behavior, while the new handler leaves config untyped despite the existing RecurConfig type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts independently implement occurrence selection and adjustment already handled by shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily skip-versus-move policy appears as isKept in getNextDate, a separate iteration branch in getUpcomingDates, nested conditions in getDatesInRange, and skipsDays/moveWeekend flags in schedule-template.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays, getNextDate gains the daily exception, and policy remains outside the shared definition in both app handlers and the two budget getNextDate/adjustment call sites.
